upstreamCoverage: Unicode 11.0.0 characters represented in the upstream Kangxi radical-stroke table; original entries and supplements
countingConvention: Kangxi radical-restored stroke count, not modern handwriting strokes and not Unicode kTotalStrokes
transformation: CSV Value/Strokes columns converted losslessly to a JSON string-to-integer dictionary keyed by decimal Unicode scalar. No traditional-form folding or numeric-name-school overrides.
limits: Counts attach to the exact input glyph. 陈=13 and 陳=16 are distinct entries; 张=7 and 張=11 are distinct entries. Name numerology that uses traditional forms must resolve the written traditional name separately.
Ambiguous simplified-to-traditional conversions must not be silently treated as confirmed names.
The dictionary radical convention does not implement name-school numeric substitutions such as treating 五 as 5 or 七 as 7.
Upstream transcription has not been independently verified for all 63,696 entries. Common fixture checks are documented.
Do not decode this table with glyph keys: Swift String canonical equivalence merges 290 compatibility entries, including 8 differing-count pairs. Scalar keys preserve original glyph-specific counts.
format: JSON dictionary: Unicode scalar decimal string -> Kangxi radical-restored stroke count. Example: 清 U+6E05 -> "28165":12. Use String(character.unicodeScalars.first!.value) as lookup key.
